---
format: gfm
---


```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
render_yml <- function(path, heading) {
  items <- yaml::read_yaml(path)
  cat("\n### ", heading, "\n\n", sep = "")
  for (item in items) {
    head <- paste(
      c(item$title, item$description, item$location),
      collapse = ", "
    )
    date <- if (!is.null(item$date)) paste0(" (", item$date, ")") else ""
    cat("**", head, "**", date, "\n\n", sep = "")
    if (
      is.null(item$details) && !is.null(item$description) && is.null(item$title)
    ) {
      next
    }
    for (d in item$details) {
      cat("- ", d, "\n", sep = "")
    }
    if (length(item$details)) cat("\n")
  }
}

render_yml("assets/yml/work.yml", "Experience")
render_yml("assets/yml/education.yml", "Education")
render_yml("assets/yml/skill.yml", "Skills")
```
